vm-bench github.com/erigontech/vm-bench

Where erigon is slower than reth, Nethermind, geth, evmone and revm, and whether the dbg build (main + open PRs) regressed. Measured every night: the Progress trend shows main, the tables show the latest dbg build unless a section says main. In the BAL-on tier erigon runs commitment v3 (ERIGON_COMMITMENT_V3=true) since 2026-11-22; the night of 2026-11-21 is the last v2 night, the before of that switch.
